tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lcags sdig gi bstod bskul mdor bsdus bzhugs so// hūm̐ chos dbyings drag po e yi zhing khams su// dur khrod rab 'jigs rol pa'i gzhal yas khang*// mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong bsnol zhing*// phyogs skyong gshin rje ma he chu glang dang*// 'khor lo pad+ma nyi zla'i khri steng du// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun dang dbyer med pa'i// phyag rgya zil gnon 'jam dpal khro bo'i rgyal// ya ma rā dza phyag na rdo rje dang*// rus sbal rngam pa mkha' lding bya khyung bcas// sbyor sgrol dbyings yum rtsa ba'i lha chen drug /khyung seng stag sbrul gyad gnon sprul pa brgyad// sku gsung thugs sprul tshe srog 'chi bdag gsum// srung zlog las mdzad stobs chen khro bo bcu// rtsa chen bzhi srung gsang ba'i gshed chen bzhi// tshogs brgyad srung byed phyi nang mon bdud brgyad// khram bdag zla ba'i 'chi bdag bcu gnyis dang*// zhag la dbang byed gshin rje sum cu gnyis// dus bzhi srid pa'i thun bdag sgo ba bzhi// za ma'i gshin rje bdun brgya nyi shur bcas// phyogs skyong rgyal chen ma yams brtan ma'i tshogs// snang srid lha srin dregs pa sngags kyi bdag /rdo rje rigs kyi srung ma bye bar bcas| /'dir gshegs thugs dam gnyan po gnad nas bskul// dam rdzas sman raka gtor ma dgra bgegs kyi// sha khrag rus pa rkang klad nang rol dang*// phung khams skye mched rnam shes gos rgyan bcas// mchod par 'bul gyi bzhes shig kha raṃ khā hi// bzhes nas sngags 'chang bdag cag srung skyob dang*// dbang dang byin rlabs mthu rtsal dngos grub stsol// dgra bgegs zlog bsad gzir mnan drag po'i las// mngon spyod drag po myur du 'grub pa dang*// dam nyams byad ma rang gshed rang la phob// bcol ba'i phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod// ces pa ni lcags sdig gi las drug mchod rten brub khung tsit+ta la brten nas 'khor lo rkyang pa sogs gang sgrub kyang thun drug sogs la gtor 'bul dang bstod bskul 'di bya ba yin no//
